**Special solo‑artist exhibitions at Moderna Museet (Stockholm) in 2022 that featured artists who were *already deceased* at the time of the show**

| Exhibition title (date 2022) | Artist | Date of death | Notes |
|------------------------------|--------|---------------|-------|
| **The Ten Largest** | *Hilma af Klint* | 1944 | A solo retrospective of one of the most famous Swedish‑born artists, the show ran 22 Sept 2022 – 8 Jan 2023. |
| **In Lady Barclay’s salon** | *Charlotte Stein (a.k.a. “Lady Barclay”)* | 1912 | The exhibition, running 2 Apr 2022 – 18 Sep 2022, was a historical collection centered solely on the pioneering photographer Lady Barclay. |

No other solo‑artist exhibitions in 2022 at Moderna Museet were run for artists who had already died by that time. Every other solo show listed for 2022 featured artists who were living when the exhibitions opened.
